name: pencil-puzzle-bench
description:
Pencil Puzzle Bench Dataset
	


This repository contains the puzzle datasets and benchmark results for Pencil Puzzle Bench.
Read the Paper | Website & Leaderboard
62,231 puzzles across 94 puzzle types with verified unique solutions.

	
		
	
	
		Files
	


	
		
	
	
		Puzzle Datasets
	


full_dataset.jsonl - Full dataset (62,231 puzzles)
golden_300.jsonl - 300 puzzles (20 types × 15 each) for standard evaluation
golden_30.jsonl - 30-puzzle subset for expensive/agentic strategies… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/bluecoconut/pencil-puzzle-bench.
reputation: Widely used in the algorithmic-puzzle and reasoning community as a large, diverse benchmark with an active leaderboard and research use.
